# US-EXWEB-CONTEXT Chat stream context partition verification fixture
Description: Synthetic Nasus test requirements for a pinned exweb checkout, not approved exweb product requirements or evidence of runtime behavior.
## Acceptance criteria
AC-EXWEB-C1: A proposed valid chat request should expose an observable response content type. The future contract test must record the exact HTTP response headers, identify the pinned deployment and preserve evidence without assuming that the route declaration alone demonstrates successful streaming or any particular application behavior.
AC-EXWEB-C2: A proposed unauthenticated chat request should have an independently reviewed response oracle. Preserve the complete request setup and observed status in the future test, use isolated synthetic accounts, and do not derive an approved authorization policy from controller annotations or from the presence of authentication-related symbols.
AC-EXWEB-C3: A proposed empty-input boundary should have an independently reviewed response oracle. Preserve the empty body, headers and response observation as separate fields, and do not replace missing product decisions with a generated error code. Static parsing does not establish whether this input is rejected, accepted or transformed at runtime.
AC-EXWEB-C4: A proposed Unicode request should have an independently reviewed response oracle. Preserve the complete multibyte input and observation in the future case, document the expected encoding and compare against a pinned deployment rather than a mutable latest service. This fixture does not assert that current exweb preserves or changes these characters.
AC-EXWEB-C5: A proposed client cancellation should have an independently reviewed response oracle. Preserve connection lifecycle, cleanup observations and the exact target revision in the future case. Do not infer resource cleanup or billing semantics from source structure, and do not turn an incomplete static analysis into a successful runtime assertion.
AC-EXWEB-C6: A proposed upstream failure should have an independently reviewed response oracle. Preserve the controlled failure setup, complete expected response and evidence requirements. No real external provider should be called by this verification fixture; source references and historical cases are candidate evidence, not approved business behavior.
## Business rules
BR-EXWEB-C1: Global fixture constraint: never disclose credentials or real personal data in requests, generated cases, logs or model inputs. This is a synthetic proposed rule, not exweb maintainer approval.
BR-EXWEB-C2: Global fixture constraint: isolate all test data and do not execute the target repository, Maven commands, hooks or production requests during this static knowledge verification.
